description.value:
Once you reach 5th level, you gain the following racial trait. 
Once per long rest, you can pluck a fistful of your feathers to take up to 5 chaos damage. You toss these into the air and give a harsh spin of your wings to create a 5ft twister adjacent to you. The vortex violently spins with sharpened feathers for 1 minute or until a large enough gust of wind can disperse it. 
Any creature who moves into the vortex’s space on their turn, or else starts their turn inside of it, takes 1d4 damage per chaos damage you took when initiating this ability, up to 5d4 damage.
